title: Elite Conservation Extremists
description: Elite Conservation Extremists — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Kwale

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Kill 5 Ice Orok Warrior Agitator Leaders and 35 Ice Orok Warrior Agitators in the branches off Upper Algor's Terror-Dome.

Quest Reward: 5000 gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Soldier Kwale

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Slay 5 Ice Orok Warrior Agitator Leaders and 25 Ice Orok Warrior Agitators in the Branches off of Upper Algor's Terror-Dome then Return to Soldier Kwale in Algor's Staging Area.

Offer:

Thanks to your tireless efforts we have a bead on the Ice Oroks that Algor is relying on heavily to run things in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome. It appears that the Ice Orok Warriors are Algor's real brawn behind this plan. They are the Oroks that are responsible for scheduling all of the Agitators activities, packing all the sack lunches, and making sure the chartered wagons show up on time.

Get out there and slay 5 of the Ice Orok Warrior Agitator Leaders and 25 Ice Orok Warrior Agitators in the branches off of Upper Algor's Terror-Dome. Return to me, Soldier Kwale, here in Algor's Staging Area, when you have finished with them.

Turn-in:

Oh yeah, that must have really put a hurt on them. Great work and here is a little something for you.

Objectives:

  • Slain Ice Orok Warrior Agitators
  • Slain Ice Orok Warrior Agitator Leaders

Level range: 20–25
